tools.name: atera_get_account
tools.description: Fetch the Atera account this key belongs to — company name, plan, country and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Atera: GET /api/v3/account.

tools.name: atera_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers (client companies) managed in Atera, paginated. Atera: GET /api/v3/customers.

tools.name: atera_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id — address, domain, phone, notes. Atera: GET /api/v3/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_list_agents
tools.description: List Atera agents — the managed machines — with online status, last seen, OS, hardware and logged-in user. Pass customer_id to list only one customer's devices. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents or GET /api/v3/agents/customer/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_get_agent
tools.description: Fetch a single agent by its AgentID — full device inventory, online status, IPs, OS build and last reboot. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/{agentId}.

tools.name: atera_find_agents_by_machine
tools.description: Find the agent(s) installed on a machine by its machine name, e.g. DESKTOP-4F2K9. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/machine/{machineName}.

tools.name: atera_get_agent_patches
tools.description: List the Windows/OS patches on one device — either those still AVAILABLE (missing) or those already INSTALLED. Takes the device's DeviceGuid (from atera_list_agents / atera_get_agent), not the AgentID. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/{deviceGuid}/available-patches or /installed-patches.

tools.name: atera_list_alerts
tools.description: List monitoring alerts (disk, CPU, availability, hardware...) with severity, device, customer and linked ticket. Filter by status. Atera: GET /api/v3/alerts.

tools.name: atera_list_tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets with priority, status, type, end user, technician, SLA durations and last comments. Filter by customer and/or status. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets.

tools.name: atera_get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by its TicketID. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: atera_list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List the comment thread on one ticket — end-user and technician replies, with internal notes flagged. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: atera_list_ticket_work_hours
tools.description: List the time entries logged on one ticket — technician, start/end, billable, on-site, rate. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/workhoursrecords.

tools.name: atera_list_contacts
tools.description: List end-user contacts, optionally searching by whole or partial email or phone number. Atera: GET /api/v3/contacts.

tools.name: atera_list_contracts
tools.description: List service contracts (retainer, block hours, hourly, remote monitoring...) with their rates and billing periods. Pass customer_id for one customer's contracts. Atera: GET /api/v3/contracts or GET /api/v3/contracts/customer/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_list_kb_articles
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles with their product, keywords, section, category and ratings. Atera: GET /api/v3/knowledgebases.

tools.name: atera_create_ticket
tools.description: Open a new helpdesk ticket. Give either end_user_id (an existing contact's EndUserID) or all of end_user_first_name, end_user_last_name and end_user_email to create a new contact with it. Atera: POST /api/v3/tickets.

tools.name: atera_update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's title, status, type, priority, impact or assigned technician. Only the fields you pass are sent. Atera: PUT /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: atera_add_ticket_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket, either as a technician (technician_id, with is_internal=true for a private note or false for a reply the end user sees) or on behalf of an end user (enduser_id). Atera: POST /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: atera_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new end-user contact under an existing customer (give customer_id or customer_name). Atera: POST /api/v3/contacts.

tools.name: atera_resolve_alert
tools.description: Mark one monitoring alert as resolved. If the underlying condition persists, Atera raises it again on the next check. Atera: PUT /api/v3/alerts/{alertId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: atera_list_alerts, atera_list_tickets, atera_get_ticket, atera_list_ticket_comments, atera_list_ticket_work_hours, atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket · Private data: atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket, atera_add_ticket_comment, atera_create_contact · Public sink: atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket, atera_add_ticket_comment, atera_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: atera_list_alerts, atera_list_tickets, atera_get_ticket, atera_list_ticket_comments, atera_list_ticket_work_hours, atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket · Private data: atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket, atera_add_ticket_comment, atera_create_contact · Public sink: atera_list_contacts, atera_create_ticket, atera_add_ticket_comment, atera_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
